sections.content: Use mucho, poco, bastante, demasiado, suficiente and expressions such as más que, menos que and tanto como to compare amounts of money, spending and resources.

items.spanish: Tengo menos gastos este mes que el mes pasado.
items.english: I have fewer expenses this month than last month.

items.spanish: Necesitamos suficiente dinero para pagar el alquiler.
items.english: We need enough money to pay the rent.

items.spanish: Este mes gasto demasiado en comida.
items.english: This month I spend too much on food.

items.spanish: Mi presupuesto es tan importante como mis ingresos.
items.english: My budget is as important as my income.

sections.content: Compare amounts precisely and distinguish between enough, too much and not enough.
